datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys to collect Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) data across Mali. Geographic boundaries and IPC phase classifications were compiled into spatial datasets (GeoJSON/KML format) for January and February 2022 near-term projections, representing modeled food insecurity impact scenarios.
